posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md:
Hi Jem,

I split this into a new topic. Look for wler's laser page for some good information on the Lexel lasers. From what I remember, you can add an etalon easily to the long frame laser. If you have the short frame you can't use the stock Lexel part but people have fit one in. The etalon has to be inside the cavity to work but you can make it removable as long as you don't mind tunning it everytime you reinstall it.
